name: PixelImage
description: An image that resolves from coarse pixel blocks to sharp when it scrolls into view. The real image is always in the page (server HTML, no JavaScript, print); the blocks are a hidden canvas drawn over it and removed when done.

children.description: Your own image element. Use this or src plus alt.

src.description: Image URL, when not passing children.

alt.description: Alternative text for src. Use an empty string for a decorative image.

blockSize.description: Size in px of the first, coarsest blocks. The blocks halve each step until the image is sharp.

whenInView.description: Wait until the image scrolls into view before resolving.

isStill.description: Shows the sharp image at once.

requirements: The real image is always rendered first, with its alt text, so it is complete with no JavaScript and in print
The canvas of blocks is decoration: aria-hidden, pointer-events none, removed when the effect finishes
The effect runs once and lasts about a second; it never loops and never flashes
Skipped for prefers-reduced-motion, inside rdm-still and with isStill: the sharp image is shown
If the canvas cannot be used the image simply stays visible
screenReader: Read as an ordinary image with its alt text; the effect is not announced

use_when: A hero or feature picture that should arrive with a little character
avoid_when: Images the reader must see immediately
anti_patterns: Using it on every image on a page
